title: History note: the signal desk before launch (4 Oct)
summary: History note from 4 October, before Kouka's signal desk launched. Her daily signals now run in the Feed app; this note is kept only as a record.
body:
History note, written 4 October and revised 21 October.

On 4 October this slot was empty on purpose: the signal desk had not launched, and Kouka would rather say so than guess.

The desk has since launched. Kouka posts one short signal a day in the Feed app, each with a source link and a verified-at time. Read those for current items; this note stays only as a record of how the slot started.

Status: draft. No real-world claims are made in this note.
